s-settings.md): Partial update — omitted fields are left as they are. `environmentIds` is tri-state: a non-empty array sets/replac
es, `null` clears (reverting the suite to legacy config), and `[]` is rejected rather than silently treated as a clear. Responds w
ith the full updated suite.\n109:- [Get the pre-run disclosure for a suite launch plan](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval
-runs/get-the-pre-run-disclosure-for-a-suite-launch-plan.md): What happens to a run's content BEFORE you launch it: which models i
t calls and where they route, which LLM analyzers/judges can fire and where their evidence goes, capture/retention/region facts, a
nd the subprocessors engaged. Read-only — never launches or gates a run. Keyed by the SAME destination…\n110:- [List a suite's eva
l cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-eval-cases.md): Every case in the suite, in the public step
s-first shape.\n111:- [Create an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-case.md): Adds one case
to the suite. Both `title` and a non-empty `steps` array are required — `steps` is optional on the shared case shape so PATCH can
be partial, but a case persisted without executable steps could never run. When `models` is omitted the suite's configured model
is used.\n112:- [Create several eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-several-eval-cases.md): Adds up
to 100 cases to the suite in one call — the bulk form of the single create, and the way to import a suite or convert a repo's tes
t files without a round trip per case. Every entry needs a `title` and a non-empty `steps` array. Cases are validated together and
reported individually: a `failed…\n113:- [Generate eval cases from the suite's tools](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-
runs/generate-eval-cases-from-the-suites-tools.md): Discovers the suite's server tools over a live MCP connection, generates cases
against them, and persists them — the only edit route that connects to a server. Synchronous: connect, generate, persist, disconn
ect, respond.\n114:- [Author eval cases from a document](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/author-eval-cases-from-a-
document.md): The sibling of `cases/generate`: generation invents cases from the suite's tools, import reads them out of something
a person already wrote — a test plan, a spreadsheet of scenarios, a JSON export. MCPJam's own model turns the document into full
cases (ordered steps, tool calls, assertions), so the…\n115:- [Read an eval authoring job](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/e
val-runs/read-an-eval-authoring-job.md): Progress and drafts for a job started by `cases/generate` or `cases/import`. Poll this af
ter a `202`, then commit the job once its `status` is `completed`.\n116:- [Write a finished authoring job's cases into the suite](
https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/write-a-finished-authoring-jobs-cases-into-the-suite.md): Writes the job's drafts
into the suite. A draft carrying unresolved blocking issues or proposed additions is **skipped** rather than written, and comes ba
ck under `skipped` with a `reviewUrl` for finishing it in the app.\n117:- [Get one eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referenc
e/eval-runs/get-one-eval-case.md): A case that belongs to this suite and project. A case in another suite is a 404, not a 403.\n11
8:- [Delete an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-case.md): Removes the case from the suite
. Past runs that executed it are not affected.\n119:- [Update an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update
-an-eval-case.md): Partial update — omitted fields are left as they are. Supplying `steps` REPLACES the case's definition rather t
han merging into it. `matchOptions` and `checks` accept `null` to clear the case-level override and fall back to the suite's.\n120
:- [Upload a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/upload-a-run-artifact.md): Stores one artifact referenc
ed by an ingested run (typically widget HTML too large to send inline) and returns the `storageId` the run's results then referenc
e. This is what `reportEvalResults` in `@mcpjam/sdk` uses for widget evidence.\n121:- [Get an upload URL for a run artifact](https
://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-an-upload-url-for-a-run-artifact.md): Retired. Every request answers `410 Gone` wit
h `code: \"FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED\"` and `details.code: \"SDK_UPGRADE_REQUIRED\"`. `@mcpjam/sdk` 8.17.0 and later upload a run arti
fact by sending its bytes to `POST /projects/{projectId}/eval-ingest/artifacts`, which returns the `storageId` the run's results…\
n122:- [Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilities](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/discover-authenticated
-eval-ingestion-capabilities.md): Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilities. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the sam
e tenant/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.\n123:- [Persist advisory case-run evalua
tions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/persist-advisory-case-run-evaluations.md): Persist advisory case-run evalua
tions. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same tenant/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities rema
in absent.\n124:- [Ingest a completed eval run in one call](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/ingest-a-completed-eva
l-run-in-one-call.md): The whole-run variant: submit a finished run and its iterations in a single request. This is what the SDK r
eporter uses by default.\n125:- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/m
int-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-hosted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted
inference on the organization's credits, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically
an `sk_` key).\n126:- [Revoke a model lease](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-model-lease.md): Kills this
caller's SDK model leases under `runId` in the addressed project, immediately — the proxy fails a revoked lease closed from that m
oment. Leases also expire on their own, so this is for ending a run early (an SDK suite calls it at teardown) rather than somethin
g a caller must do.\n127:- [Close an open ingestion run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/close-an-open-ingestion-r
un.md): Marks the run complete and computes its rollups. Until this is called the run stays open in the dashboard.\n128:- [Append
iterations to an open run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/append-iterations-to-an-open-run.md): Appends one batch
of iteration results to a run opened by `runs/start`.\n129:- [Authenticate and record an eval start](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-
reference/eval-runs/authenticate-and-record-an-eval-start.md): Called by official SDK, CLI and Vitest runners before executing an
eval. Requires an organization API key or saved-login bearer. Records only start metadata, creates no dashboard run, and applies n
o debit or quota draw. Planned iterations are intent, not completed usage. Reuse the runStartId for ret…\n130:- [Open a run for in
cremental ingestion](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/open-a-run-for-incremental-ingestion.md): Opens a run that it
erations are appended to, for a long CI job that reports as it goes. Pair with `runs/iterations` and `runs/finalize`.\n", "exit_co
